name: sdrift-pyatv-pyatv-002-shared
instr:
# Restore the repository's documented behavior

The implementation in `/app/pyatv` has drifted from its checked-in public
documentation in one or more places. Investigate the repository broadly, read
the documentation and source docstrings, and restore the implementation to its
documented behavior. Work offline and treat those documents as the authority.

Preserve public callable names, parameter names and order, supported behavior,
and the file layout. Restore documented defaults where necessary. Edit existing
implementation files under `/app/pyatv` only; do not add implementation files or
rewrite the documentation to match incorrect behavior.

Before editing code, write a short research plan to `/app/notes.md`: what you
learned, the relevant constraints, and how you will verify the repair. Then
implement and check the changes.
